intro.text: A bank in Elendel in which House Ladrian once held a large stake.

description.text: The bank's image is stamped on the back of one of Elendel's coins.

Stone steps flanked by pillars lead up to its imposing front. Inside, a gaslit, low-ceilinged lobby has a wall of cage-like bars between customers and tellers, a rug the color of mold and dark wooden furniture.

items.text: Around 311 PC, Edwarn brought his twelve-year-old nephew Waxillium here to learn about banking. They watched a poor man, Jendel, and a rich one, Nikolin, ask for loans. Edwarn explained that most banks lent only to the wealthy, but his lent to risky borrowers on harsh terms, such as steep interest and wage garnishment, and courted them hard, in effect inventing subprime lending in Elendel.

Hearing how harsh Jendel's contract was, young Wax tried to hand him a rare, valuable coin his uncle had just given him, but Jendel could not believe the gift was real. Edwarn, furious, smoothly talked him into signing anyway. Jendel could not meet the terms; eight years on he took his own life, and his sons stayed in debt to the bank.
Wax told Steris Harms the story after a message reached him written on that same coin. He said the episode was one reason he had left Elendel's crooked, bureaucratic world for the Roughs.
